1,570 reviews. 4.8 stars. At an Indian vegetarian restaurant in the middle of Phu Quoc.

RАСОИ INDIAN PURE VEGETARIAN RESTAURANT on 97 Đường Trần Hưng Đạo hits different. No meat. No shortcuts. Just proper dal, fresh paneer dishes, and curries that taste like someone's grandmother made them.

If you've been surviving on seafood and spring rolls, this is your reset meal. Budget $15-30 per person.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
